gloss_en: The 'luminaries of fire' (me'orei eish) — the kabbalistic forces of harsh judgment (dinim) that prevail when the 'luminaries of light' (me'orei or, associated with the Name of God, the light of the eyes, and Shabbat) are subdued; in Likutey Moharan II:67 they are the burning force behind the destruction of the Holy Temple, linked to fire and ash
